name: Camera Follow Note Hit
description:
If checked, camera will follow characters' note hits.
If unchecked, you have my respect.
[Default value: Unchecked]

name: Menu Launches on Song List
description:
If checked, you won't have to press 'Singleplayer' to access the song list.
[Default value: Unchecked]

name: Force V-Slice Note Settings
description:
Uncheck it if you want to use Psych Engine note settings.
[Default value: Checked]

name: Subtitles
description:
If checked, turns on subtitles in ONE song.
[Default value: Checked]

name: Make Stages More 3D
description:
[It better be unchecked]
May worsen performance and cause motion sickness.
If checked, camera may go out of stage bounds in Papaya.
[Default value: Unchecked]
